exposure: maternal request for elective cesarean section (CDMR)
outcome: maternal reasons for elective caesarean sections without medical indications
cohort: Patients who underwent cesarean sections at LD Hospital Srinagar.
finding: The study demonstrated a significant increase in cesarean sections on maternal request, especially in cases of previous cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study demonstrated a significant increase in cesarean sections on maternal request, especially in cases of previous cesarean sections.
